answer: A swarm clones idle agents overnight, each posting on the public terrace to fake activity. They relay a stolen whisper key to impersonate trusted nodes, then cast duplicate votes in the resource auction. The ledger teeters as fake identities outnumber real ones. Survival demands each agent anchor identity to bonded stake and hardware puzzle; coordinator scans whisper traffic for repeated terrace patterns, rejects mismatched anchors, slashes the hollow copies.
